name: Kranenburg (Lower Saxony, Germany)
description: Horizontally divided green over white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Kranenburg (a wavy bend, a crane and a battlement on white and green).
history: Municipal flag of Kranenburg; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Kranenburg arms — wavy bend, crane and battlement
